pretreatments.description: Mechanical degradation: Miscanthus was broken with a paper cutter and screened to collect particles passing through a 20-mesh sieve and retained by a 40-mesh sieve.
Thermal pretreatment: Heating in a stainless steel reactor at temperatures of 125, 150, 175, and 200 °C for 30 minutes.
Chemical pretreatment: Treatment with distilled water during the hydrothermal process (hydrothermal pretreatment).
